representativeSize.basis: The seven standard lengths are 148/153/155/157/159/161/164; 157 is the median. Wide 157W/161W/164W are excluded.
representativeSize.officialRow: Contact length 121 cm (not effective edge); sidecut 8.2 m; nose/waist/tail 30.1/25.8/30.1 cm; stance range 20.25-25 in (51.5-63.5 cm); setback 0; brand flex 7/10; recommended rider weight 120+ lb / 55+ kg.

mappingAndLimitations.contactLength: The historical brand chart labels this column Contact Length. It is not a published Effective Edge value; the old seed's effectiveEdge 1210 mm was a semantic mis-mapping and has been removed from prototype/YAML.
mappingAndLimitations.length: The 157 cm board length is retained as representative size; no size is inferred.
mappingAndLimitations.stance: Source gives a min-max range and zero setback, not a single reference stance. This project's current per-size seed shape cannot fully preserve this table in prototype specs; exact per-size ranges remain in this raw archive.
mappingAndLimitations.brandFlex: The official 157 flex 7/10 is stored here as source evidence only. It is not copied into the site's separately interpreted flex field without an approved normalization rule.
mappingAndLimitations.mass: The official chart contains rider-weight recommendations, not board mass. Seed board weight 2890 g lacks matching evidence and is retained pending verification.
mappingAndLimitations.construction: Season-matched copy verifies Horsepower construction and a sintered competition-ready base; the exact core ratio and glass layup were not established from a retrievable 24/25 official source, so existing core/glass strings remain provisional.
mappingAndLimitations.price: Official archived listing indexed amounts $695.99 and $869.99 but the archived page is inaccessible and does not reliably expose currency/price type/capture date; CNY 5699 is left unchanged and flagged as unverified rather than converted.
mappingAndLimitations.editorialScores: No directly verified independent ride test on a 2024-25 physical sample with disclosed conditions was found in this pass. Snowboarding Profiles has a 2024-25-labeled archive page with an 84.1/100 composite, but its only disclosed on-snow setup is a 2021 size 155 sample tested 2022-04-07 in warm slushy conditions; treat as historical direction only. The 2025-26 Snowboarding Profiles 157 test also does not match this season. Existing six-dimensional scores remain low-confidence estimates; no external composite is mapped numerically.
mappingAndLimitations.images: All four current gallery images are labeled AI placeholders. No licensed 24/25 product-photography asset has been confirmed; do not present generated art as product photography.

snowboardingProfiles2024-25Archive.conditions: Warm April slush/sticky groomers; no recent snowfall; no powder test.
snowboardingProfiles2024-25Archive.directionalObservations: The old sample was described as damp/stable at speed and capable on jumps/switch, while deep-powder evidence was spec-based and jib/pressing required effort.
snowboardingProfiles2024-25Archive.use: Season page label does not make the disclosed board a 2024-25 test sample. Treat only as historical ride-direction evidence; do not map its composite score to site dimensions.

snowboardingProfiles.use: Adjacent season only; not evidence of the 2024-25 seed's exact performance and no score mapping.
